newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Int'l Bank of Asia signs CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bank of Asia signs CD programme.

text.p: The International Bank of Asia said on Wednesday it has signed an agreement with nine other institutions to set up a HK$2.0 billion certificate of deposit issuance programme.
The evergreen programme provides for both Hong Kong and U.S. dollar issues in the form of floating rate, fixed rate and discounted certificates of deposit.
Put and call options can be incorporated under the terms of the individual issues.

The dealer group includes Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale Hong Kong branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, Fuji International Finance (HK), HSBC Markets, Peregrine Fixed Income, Sakura Finance Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale and Westpac Banking Corp.
HSBC Markets is the arranger for the programme and Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong branch is acting as reference and paying agent.
International Bank of Asia has received an A-3 short-term and BBB long-term rating from Standard and Poor's Corp.
